name: Verdict card
oneLiner: a glowing glass app window whips in from the side with motion blur (or blooms out of a dot) and settles at chest height between the hands, then a red X draws in two strokes or a green check pops on it, and it drops out of frame in a blur
say: when the speaker judges a tool, a method or a result: 'this doesn't work' (stamp x) or 'this is the one' (stamp check); cut in on the thing's name, the stamp lands on the verdict word
